recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy collage featuring young performers with musical instruments against a split-tone nature background. The composition uses a central duo as the primary focus, flanked by dynamic secondary figures, all integrated with bold, layered typography and distressed graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vocalists anchored by a large horizontal title block
Contrast between the cool blue sky and warm green forest floor
Dynamic poses creating a sense of movement and performance
Rough, torn-edge border framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Distressed yellow rectangular block for the primary title
Guitar headstock silhouette integrated into the graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two lead singers centered at the top; two guitarists positioned lower left and lower right at a slightly smaller scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, two-tiered title block in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central vocalists, moves down to the bold title, then outward to the energetic guitarists on the periphery.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures and graphic elements to convey excitement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and forest green background split horizontally.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow title block providing a central pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the secondary title text and lead singer's shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout to appeal to a young audience; high value in the sky area for clarity.

letterConstructionRules: Top tier: Blocky, slightly irregular sans-serif with internal wood-grain or distressed texture
Bottom tier: Bold, high-contrast slab-serif with thick black outlines and inner beveling
Heavy drop shadows to create depth against the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top tier have jagged, hand-cut edges
Bottom tier letters feature a slight arch or warp to follow a central axis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking a distressed, textured sans-serif over a clean, beveled slab-serif for a 'rugged vs. polished' look.
graphicDevices: Yellow rectangular banner with torn edges

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and presence for the display text.
Matches the distressed, summer-camp aesthetic of the top tier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant composite image of four energetic teenagers with musical instruments. The background should be split horizontally: the top half is a bright blue sky with wispy clouds, and the bottom half is a lush green pine forest. Apply a white, rough, hand-painted grunge border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large yellow rectangular block with distressed edges in the center. Inside the block, place the first word in a dark, textured, blocky sans-serif. Below the block, place the second word in a large, bright red, beveled slab-serif font with a thick black outline and a heavy drop shadow. Integrate a red guitar headstock silhouette on the right side of the yellow block.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow block distressed and textured?
Does the red text have a visible bevel and thick outline?
Is the background split between sky and forest?
Is the white grunge border present?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the yellow block
Angle of the guitar headstock graphic
postGenerationChecks: Check for 4 distinct figures with instruments/mics
Ensure the title is the central focus
Confirm the presence of the distressed border
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-energy youth photography with a 'rugged-musical' graphic identity using distressed blocks and beveled slab-serifs.
